status: Prespecified before any Model2.0 validation or holdout metrics were computed
holdout_status: Reused Model1.0 holdout; excluded from Model2 fitting/tuning/calibration. Previously observed Model1.0 results mean it is not a globally unseen test.

epa.definition: Locally reconstructed expected net points remaining in half from nflverse raw play-by-play; not published nflfastR next-score EPA
epa.ep_training_cutoff: Previous-season game results available strictly before season first kickoff
epa.first_season: Fixed zero-EP warmup prior, no future-data bootstrap
epa.published_epa: Excluded: shared learned EP model may incorporate later seasons

qb: Most dropbacks in latest available prior team game; prior performance of that QB, never target-game starter

uncertainty.method: Paired season/week block bootstrap, fixed forecasts, identical draws
uncertainty.multiplicity: Unadjusted exploratory intervals; no blanket superiority claim

policy: No tuning or feature choice using 2025. Source corrections and absent archived publication timestamps remain limitations. No real-money trades.
